issue: GEM holds Iran NIOC LNG (Iran LNG, Tombak Port) at 'construction / actual' (LastUpdated 2025-09-03). HOWEVER two material events POST-DATE the GEM update and meaningfully worsen near-term viability: (1) UN 'snapback' sanctions were reimposed on Iran 28 Sep 2025 (E3-initiated 28 Aug 2025), restoring the pre-JCPOA UN sanctions regime and further cutting Iran off from liquefaction technology and finance; (2) the 2026 Iran war (US/Israeli strikes from late Feb 2026) and the Strait of Hormuz closure (4 Mar 2026) stranded regional gas/LNG exports and damaged Gulf LNG infrastructure (Qatar Ras Laffan). No source explicitly documents a construction halt at the Tombak site itself, so I am NOT recommending a status field edit. But the project's stated 2026 commissioning is now almost certainly unachievable, and the record may warrant re-assessment toward stalled/mothballed at the next review.
